name: Twinlock
description: Balance two-sided vaults, then decide whether to secure the payout or draw a blind fourth card.
components: 24 numbered cards; three vaults; three-card hand.
loop: Place cards on either side of a vault; the closer the sums, the higher the payout. Cash out early or blind-finish a three-card vault.
risk: Blind completion doubles the payout if totals are within one; otherwise the vault burns.
caveat: Small decision space but clear risk and board manipulation.
evidence: Strategy averaged 962 vs random 152 in 1,000 matched-seed runs.

name: Stepwire
description: Extend two numerical chains from either end, shaping the odds of a profitable blind finish.
components: 24 numbered cards; two five-card chains; three-card hand.
loop: Place a number on either end if it differs from its neighbor by one; bank a chain or blind-complete it.
risk: A matching unseen fifth card earns double payout; a non-fitting card burns the chain.
caveat: The same multiset of cards creates different future odds depending on order.
evidence: Strategic averaged 374 vs random 168 over 1,000 seeds.

name: Tenfold
description: Arrange a 3×3 grid to create scoring lines that total ten, then risk your grid on a hidden Seal.
components: 3×3 grid; numbered deck and three-card hand.
loop: Arrange numbers so rows, columns, and diagonals produce exact-ten sums; secure points or attempt a Blind Seal.
risk: Blind Seal multiplies new line rewards but can destroy accumulated grid value.
caveat: Huge jackpots overshadow ordinary placement decisions.
evidence: Adaptive averaged 397 vs aggressive 376 in the original version; distinction was uncertain.

name: Stormfreight
description: Load cargo ships, assign valuable cards as shields, and risk the entire shipment for ×3 rewards.
components: 24 resource cards (1–6); 14 storm cards (1–7); two ships.
loop: Load up to three cargo cards and one shield per ship. Bank the cargo product or challenge a storm.
risk: A storm succeeds if storm value + previous successes ≤ shield; success triples, failure destroys the shipment.
caveat: Strong emotional loop; shield allocation creates an opportunity cost.
evidence: Strategic averaged 505 vs conservative 373 and random 203.

name: Cinderloop
description: Feed and cool a furnace to reopen risky opportunities for exponential rewards.
components: 24 numbered cards; two furnaces with heat cap 12.
loop: Feed cards to raise heat, Vent to reduce it, and Bank a furnace at its current multiplier.
risk: Stoke draws an unseen number when heat is 9–11: stay ≤12 to multiply; otherwise burn.
caveat: Extreme variance makes skilled average returns unreliable per run.
evidence: Strategic mean 250 vs conservative 155, but won fewer than half matched games.

name: Switchback
description: Build alternating high-low movements along a track and gamble on unseen reversals.
components: 24 numbered cards; one numerical track; three-card hand.
loop: Place numbers to alternate the movement direction and grow a combo up to ×8. Bank the pot or attempt Blind Turn.
risk: Reversing unseen card doubles the pot; failing loses it. Two successful blind turns trigger an auto-bank.
caveat: Card counting can make some blind turns guaranteed.

name: Beaconfall
description: Navigate a circular board to land on scoring Beacons and manage scarce banking opportunities.
components: 24 numbered cards; 7-position ring; four Bank Seals.
loop: Play a movement card clockwise, score Beacon landings, and build a combo. Bank or Surge.
risk: Unseen Surge movement doubles an eligible Beacon payout; a miss destroys the pot.
caveat: Positions change which card values are useful.

name: Rebound
description: Use positive and negative cards to manage a meter, then cross a danger line and hope to return safely.
components: 24 signed cards; one meter from −10 to +10.
loop: Place signed values in the safe zone (−6 to +6), create reversal combos, or Bank.
risk: Overload moves outside the safe zone then reveals a correction; success triples, failure salvages one quarter.
caveat: A few favorable draws dominate outcomes.
evidence: Adaptive averaged 516 vs safe 269 but won only 55% of matched runs.

name: Presspoint
description: Manipulate two threshold guards around a center card to control scoring and gambling odds.
components: 24 numbered cards; left guard, center piston, right guard; four Press Chips.
loop: Replace machine cards and score when the center is above or below both guards; alternate patterns for combo points.
risk: Blind Press stakes half or all of a pot on the center switching to the opposite pattern.
caveat: Guard adjustments change both possible rewards and probability.
evidence: Adaptive averaged 352 vs safe 188; banking was rarely used.

name: Shortfuse
description: Complete exact-sum contracts, then carry winnings into a strict two-placement deadline for multipliers.
components: 24 numbered cards; target sums 7, 9, 11; three-card hand.
loop: Place a card in a contract without exceeding its target. Completion pays at ×1, ×2, then ×4.
risk: Carry instead of Bank and complete another contract within two placements, or lose the accumulated pot.
caveat: Deliberate preparation matters more than raw blind-card luck.
evidence: Adaptive averaged 118 vs conservative 79 and insured 107.

name: Oddity
description: Maintain three collections of unique numbers, selling completed sets or risking duplicates.
components: 24 numbered cards; three jars; three-card hand.
loop: Put unique values into jars and sell collections for escalating payouts.
risk: Blindly add a card; duplicates destroy the jar, new numbers improve its payout.

name: Seam
description: Rewire a 2×2 number puzzle to create adjacent pairs that add up to seven.
components: 24 numbered cards; 2×2 grid; three Dare tokens.
loop: Replace cells to form new horizontal/vertical sum-seven links and build combos.
risk: A blind replacement doubles successful new-link rewards or halves the pot.
caveat: Dare action was used less than once per adaptive run.

name: Glassfire
description: Fill a furnace and decide whether to sell the batch or fire into a narrow temperature window.
components: 24 numbered cards; one furnace; four Sparks.
loop: Feed cards into a furnace up to heat 10; each card scores by stack depth.
risk: Fire with an unseen card: total heat 7–10 triples the pot, otherwise shatters it.
caveat: Strong policies may repeatedly optimize the same heat pattern.

name: Foldline
description: Narrow a numbered interval while earning increasingly valuable folds, then gamble on an unseen card landing inside it.
components: 27 numbered cards (1–9); interval 0–10; four Dive tokens.
loop: Play cards strictly between two boundaries and move one boundary inward; cash or dive.
risk: Dive draws an unseen card that must land strictly inside the remaining interval.
caveat: Core risk mechanic resembles In-Between / Acey-Deucey.
evidence: Bold averaged 356 vs safe planner 291; rejected on originality.

name: Counterweight
description: Balance two pans, intentionally create imbalances, and gamble on an unseen card restoring equilibrium.
components: 24 numbered cards; two three-slot pans; three Press tokens.
loop: Place cards into pans, Bank their current balance-weighted payout, or Press.
risk: Press draws onto a chosen pan; a difference ≤2 adds ×3, otherwise the entire load burns.
caveat: Deliberately lowering your current payout can set up better Press odds.
evidence: Adaptive averaged 1,415 vs safe 593; bank-aware had better downside.

name: Ratchet
description: Rotate three seven-position dials and chain clicks across different dials for growing rewards.
components: 24 numbered cards; three 0–6 dials; three Overdrives.
loop: Play cards to rotate dials modulo seven. Landing on zero generates a CLICK; alternate dials to raise the combo.
risk: Overdrive reveals a card and attempts a raw total of 7–9; success triples, failure loses the pot.
caveat: Modulo arithmetic may feel like homework without clear UI.

name: Chime
description: Synchronize three countdown bells to earn multiplied rewards, then wager on a hidden Fate card.
components: 24 numbered cards; three bells; three Pledge tokens.
loop: Place countdowns, advance time by playing or burning cards, and score simultaneous rings.
risk: Pledge swaps in a hidden Fate card; make it join a triple ring within three ticks or lose the pot.
caveat: Planning is multi-turn and risky commitment follows a reveal.
evidence: Adaptive averaged 519 vs safe 378 on 200 seeds.

name: Rootweave
description: Grow connected groups on a 3×3 garden and risk your pot to graft a hidden root into the network.
components: 30 numbered cards (five each of 1–6); 3×3 grid; 3-card hand; two BANK seals and three GRAFT tokens.
loop: Place cards in empty cells. Adjacent cards differing by one form groups; harvest groups of at least two for 10 × size² points. Burn a card to prune a cell; use two seals to secure your pot.
risk: GRAFT at an empty cell with two neighboring cards: independently reveal 1–6. If it connects to two or more neighbors, quadruple the pot; otherwise lose it.
caveat: Large jackpots can dominate average scores; revision recommended.
evidence: 300 seeded games per strategy: conservative mean 1,306; adaptive mean 1,462, but higher downside.
